title_en: Famous Restaurants (17/20): A Restaurant in a Beijing Hutong
note_en: 既 A，又 B means "both A and B" and links two qualities that hold at the same time: 这家餐厅既像一座老北京的四合院，又像一个小小的民俗博物馆 "the restaurant is both like an old Beijing courtyard home and like a little folk museum." Unlike English "both... and," which can join two nouns directly, 既 and 又 each sit before a verb or adjective, so the verb 像 is repeated.
